# Template:Infobox

<div class="mw-parser-output">

A template for displaying information in a coloured box with optional icon

**Usage:**

    &#123;&#123;infobox&#125;&#125;

result:

<table>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td rowspan="2"><a href="/images/172px-Symbol_comment_vote.svg.png"><img src="/images/172px-Symbol_comment_vote.svg.png" decoding="async" width="48" height="49" alt="172px-Symbol comment vote.svg.png" /></a></td>
<td>title</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>body</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

**Usage:**

    &#123;&#123;infobox|title=My Info Box|color=rgba(0,0,0,1)|icon=Springlobby 64.png|icon-size=48
    |body=chuck content here&#125;&#125;

result:

<table>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td rowspan="2"><a href="/images/Springlobby_64.png"><img src="/images/Springlobby_64.png" decoding="async" width="48" height="48" alt="Springlobby 64.png" /></a></td>
<td>My Info Box</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>chuck content here</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

</div>
